name: What is the warranty for bedroom window replacement services?

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty for bedroom window replacement services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranties for bedroom window replacement typically cover both the product itself and the installation. Product warranties are provided by the window manufacturer and vary by brand and component, often covering defects for many years. Our installation warranty ensures that our workmanship meets industry standards. Specific warranty details will be provided in writing with your estimate and contract, outlining coverage and duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warranties cover both the window product (manufacturer) and the installation (contractor), with specific details provided in your contract.
